title: About 1,400 lines of old Charts page parts are kept but shown nowhere
what: Seventeen older Charts page pieces (body weight, calories, protein, volume, frequency, lifts, muscles, records, consistency, this-week and welcome cards, three loaders, two small chart kinds and the old exercise charts) are no longer used by any screen. They are still offered from the shared list, still kept up to date by hand, and one old loader turns failed reads into empty or zero with no warning. A later change could switch one back on with that silent behaviour.
expected: Parts no screen uses are removed, so only live code is kept and checked.
how_often: every change near the Charts page
fix_line: Delete the unused Charts parts and their entries in the shared lists

title: Tests meant to guard the Charts page check old parts the page no longer shows
what: The test that says every headline number agrees on every screen reads the Charts page through an old loader the page stopped using, so the numbers the member really sees on Charts are not part of that check. Two other tests check words inside the unused this-week card and lifts list. All of these pass whatever the live Charts page shows.
expected: The agreement test uses the same reads the live Charts page uses, and no test guards parts no screen shows.
how_often: whenever the Charts page numbers change
fix_line: Point the agreement test at the live Charts page reads and drop checks on unused parts

title: Many phone notice and Charts tests only look for words in the code
what: Tests for the Balance check card, Strength score, body map, watch update pop-up, gym logo and Couldn't save banner read the file as text and check that a line or sentence is in it. They pass even if that line never runs or the card shows something else, and fail on a harmless rename. 56 files in this area are imported by no test at all.
expected: These checks call the logic the card uses or draw the card and check what the member sees.
fix_line: Replace word-in-file checks with checks of what the card does or shows
